same_source_closed_norm_program.argument: Apply the seven-part continuation to the authenticated final mean functions, preserving original coefficient bodies, selector, common q threshold and physical cutoff window. Each finite m recursively consumes finitely many original producer orders. Weighted target Gaussian recurrence, stable pulse/inverse H/positive square roots, exact two-column commonY lift, Fourier divisor and shifted radial FTC supply finite source-only constants. The 13-call DAG has only those producer leaves and backward dependencies. Thus its final velocity/pressure rows hold for every fixed m, independently of whether high-order derivative arrays or decimal constants were printed.

actual_primary_application.argument: Reuse the existing exact primary application at isolated wave roots, not total velocity anchors. Complete physical curl, moving-frame homogeneous pressure, protected source H/positive covariance weights, original primary amplitudes and flat support are retained. The actual unchanged primary wave is still present after temporal/five mean corrections. W^1/2 and remainder W^(1-kappa) survive the actual chart maps.

wave_all_order_and_transport.argument: The original homogeneous principal ODE including pressure cancels the dangerous linear term; retain +psi_prime*t separately. Full-curl divergence cancels the apparent carrier loss in the full quadratic products. Retain tt,tr,rt,rr and both mean-wave products with the complete final mean. Exact own-label background homogeneity and whole reference-mean substitution justify the principal coefficients. Apply finite Leibniz recurrence for arbitrary m, obtaining W^(1-3kappa). The actual commonY affine and fixed-label normalization maps change only finite constants/log powers. Existing full3 source function equality transports each radial/angular/axial grouped coefficient, not merely the angular component. Flat joins give global zero extension.
wave_all_order_and_transport.flat_remainder: The actual +psi_prime*t term is F_pulse. Actual Gaussian c=(node617317*node300173)/25>0 yields C Q^-M S^P exp(-cS); every fixed physical derivative and every N is <=C_N q^N by the completed-square estimate. It is retained separately, not included in W or set to zero.

fast_cutoff_all_order.argument: Apply the exact temporal then fresh-five telescoping formulas to roots3614976/3615392. The final Etheta is initial Haar plus both slow changes; final Ez also keeps -ci N A1(gamma_desired). Using N inverse on the actual zero-mean source and commutation with the unchanged translated radial integral, this equals +A1(initialEz-Haar(initialEz)). Positive radial IBP p=49001 uses initial Ez through m+98005, a finite order supplied by the same-source theorem; it does not require a new smaller domain. Initial Haar leading-covariance cancellation is the original 9.11 primary covariance theorem. Slow changes have exponent2-3kappa; full cutoff has exponent1.49. Therefore Etheta and Ez both satisfy M^1.49, with all variable-Dr coefficient derivatives, full pressure difference and A0 terms retained.

exact_five_remainder_all_order.argument: The same fresh P/J targets enter the exact five rows. Integrating the complete8.26/8.27 identities shows final P/J equal the retained nonlinear remainder roots3615635/3615673/3615848, not zero. All19 exponent groups are >=2-2kappa using the actual temporal and slow five increments from the closed norm program; whole radial/full Haar projection absorbs finite boundary poles. Each arbitrary fixed derivative is a finite Leibniz sum on the same domain.

moments_support_domain.argument: The exact temporal inverse has zero normalized auxiliary mean; the translated T1 realization preserves that mean. Positive bump moments mu_p, positive a/lambda and d=1/5 give distinct angular nodes exp(2d),exp((-2-2lambda)d),exp(-2lambda*d) and positive axial gap 1-exp(-2d*lambda), so the same fixed five map is invertible. Its two homogeneous actual rows have zero targets, proving both9.10 weighted moments. Primary curls and mean potentials are divergence free with original flat radial support. Fixed-label/copy derivatives never differentiate floor or carrier rounding. Compatible finite prefixes share the same selector; every omitted term and derivative is identically zero and ODE uniqueness identifies overlaps. No single truncated polynomial is asserted valid for allq.
uniform_prefix_chain: The original commonRecursiveSelector imposes diagonal derivative clauses m<=n and preserves earlier b_n when extended.

For each fixed derivative m, finitely many low-index coefficient norms are bounded directly; all higher indices obey the selector geometric-tail estimate. This gives one finite source constant independent of the valid prefix.

At any q>0 select a valid prefix with b_(N+1)*q>=1. Omitted terms and all cutoff derivatives are exactly zero. On overlaps the same coefficients, matrices and ODE uniqueness identify the fields.

The complete cover and whole-radial integrals use one common q and one shared valid prefix; actual commonY maps preserve qActual, X and eta. Thus these compatible local proofs form the same original q<qGlobalStar source, without changing q_big for the requested derivative order.

retained_full_flat_residual.argument: The complete Definition9.4/Proposition9.3 residual retains the inherited background flat residual E_B, the separate pulse F_pulse, and modified radial integral remainders including actual A0=chi_R*whole(g_r-rhoP). It is not asserted that the whole flat residual equals F_pulse. source-radial-class-majorants.mjs174-289 proves for every fixed output m and positive integer p the exact original A_e operator estimate with exponent gain p*kappa_s and finite input demand m+2p+3. The same-source theorem supplies that finite order on the same domain. Since h>0 and kappa_s>0, choose p to dominate any prescribed physical derivative/normalization loss and desired q order; this proves all-order physical flatness of retained A0 and any remaining A_e terms. Keep the actual centered fullY source and its normalized whole-Haar identity; neither pressure A0 nor the new defects are declared zero.
